notes.note: Reviewed against #3628. session-agent-resolution.ts adds an optional isCoordinatorSession port and a module-private withCoordinatorCapabilities: a person-designated coordinator Session gets the built-in Station tool servers and default auto-approvals, with authored values (autoApprove included) winning and delivery still decided by the unchanged per-engine matrix and passthrough (ACP only with HTTP MCP). The latest commits only made that helper module-private and reformatted it. Every other Session resolves exactly as before, and this document claims nothing that the opt-in path contradicts, so it remains accurate.
